prompt:
There are 6 houses in a row, numbered 1 to 6 from left to right. Each house has exactly one resident. Every resident has one value for each attribute below, and no two residents share a value within an attribute.

Attributes and their possible values:
- name: Alice, Bob, Eve, David, Carol, Frank
- color: blue, purple, red, green, white, yellow
- pet: cat, horse, rabbit, fish, bird, dog
- drink: milk, tea, juice, coffee, soda, water
- hobby: cooking, reading, chess, gardening, cycling, painting

Clues:

2. Alice and the person whose favorite color is white live next to each other.
3. The person whose hobby is reading lives directly to the left of the person whose hobby is gardening.
4. The person whose favorite drink is water does not live in house 2.
5. The person whose pet is horse lives somewhere to the left of the person whose favorite color is red.
6. Carol lives somewhere to the left of Alice.
7. The person whose hobby is cooking and the person whose favorite color is white live next to each other.
8. The person whose favorite drink is milk and the person whose favorite color is yellow are not the same person.
9. The person whose favorite drink is coffee lives in house 4.
10. Eve lives somewhere to the left of the person whose pet is fish.
11. The person whose favorite drink is milk lives somewhere to the left of the person whose favorite color is purple.
12. Frank lives in house 2.
13. The person whose pet is dog lives in house 4.
14. The person whose favorite color is white lives somewhere to the left of the person whose favorite drink is juice.
15. Bob lives somewhere to the left of the person whose hobby is cooking.
16. The person whose pet is rabbit lives in house 2.
17. Frank and the person whose favorite color is white live next to each other.
18. The person whose hobby is cycling lives somewhere to the left of the person whose pet is cat.
19. The person whose favorite drink is milk and the person whose pet is fish live next to each other.
20. The person whose pet is bird and the person whose hobby is chess live next to each other.
21. Carol and the person whose pet is cat are not the same person.
22. The person whose pet is horse lives somewhere to the left of the person whose favorite color is yellow.
23. The person whose hobby is reading and the person whose pet is cat are not the same person.
24. The person whose favorite color is blue and the person whose pet is dog are the same person.

Determine which values belong to each house. Submit your answer as JSON with exactly these keys: {"name": [...], "color": [...], "pet": [...], "drink": [...], "hobby": [...]}. Each list has 6 entries, the value in house 1 first and the value in house 6 last.
